_comment: qwen2.5-coder reliably calls real tools; plain qwen2.5 (the chat personas' model) mostly just describes JSON instead of sending it. Change `model` here if you pull something better at tool-calling — nothing else needs editing. max_tool_rounds caps the desktop's pre-chat loop per server; max_agent_rounds is only a backstop for the gateway's conversational loop, which normally ends when the model answers.
